## Golazo Project

### Environment
- Azure subscription: Visual Studio Enterprise (146099412+samoletovs@users.noreply.github.com)
- Azure region: northeurope
- GitHub: samoletovs/golazo (private)

### Tech Stack
- React 19 + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind CSS 4
- Azure Static Web Apps for hosting
- Azure Functions API + Cosmos DB backend
- i18n: react-i18next (RU, LV, EN, ES)

### Practices
- TypeScript strict mode, no `any`
- Functional components with hooks
- Mobile-first design (375px primary breakpoint)
- Touch targets: minimum 44px
- All user-facing strings via react-i18next
- State: React Context + localStorage + API sync
- Commit frequently with clear messages
- Push to `master` branch on GitHub

### Design
- Dark theme with pitch green accents
- FIFA/EA FC aesthetic — energetic, not childish
- Emoji-based ratings (5-point scale)
- Rank colors: bronze/silver/gold/diamond/platinum
